name: hcloud-go-opaque-schema-extension-preservation
instr:
hcloud-go cannot preserve API fields it does not yet understand. Preserve opaque JSON extensions through decoding, public/schema conversion, request creation, and converter regeneration without changing declared-field behavior.

`ExtensionFields`, `NewExtensionFields`, `ExtensionFields.Get`, `ExtensionFields.Set`, and `ExtensionFields.Clone` must preserve supplied bytes without sharing mutable storage. Certificate, network, load-balancer-type, and load-balancer schema values must preserve unknown members through JSON and bidirectional conversion, without changing their established time, pricing, status, reference, IP, subnet, route, membership, or label handling.

Load-balancer creation must preserve independent extensions at the root, algorithm, service, HTTP, health-check, and health-check HTTP boundaries. `LoadBalancerClient.Create` must send them through its existing workflow. Declared members remain authoritative. Malformed values, empty names, and collisions must fail atomically before transport with an `ExtensionError`; `ExtensionError.Error` must identify the offending `Name` and `Reason` during mutation, conversion, encoding, and creation.

`Certificate.GetExtensions`, `Certificate.SetExtension`, `Network.GetExtensions`, `Network.SetExtension`, `LoadBalancerType.GetExtensions`, `LoadBalancerType.SetExtension`, `LoadBalancerCreateOpts.GetExtensions`, `LoadBalancerCreateOpts.SetExtension`, and the corresponding `GetExtensions` and `SetExtension` methods on `LoadBalance
